tools.name: typless_list_awaiting_poll
tools.description: List extraction ids that finished in the last 2 days and were not polled yet. Use typless_get_extraction with each id to read the result. Typless API: GET /api/v1/awaiting-poll.

tools.name: typless_get_extraction
tools.description: Get the status and result of one extraction by extraction_id. status is IN_PROGRESS, SUCCESS, ERROR or EXPIRED; result is empty until the status is SUCCESS. Calling it also removes the id from typless_list_awaiting_poll. The result is deleted 48 hours after processing finishes. Typless API: GET /api

tools.name: typless_extract_data
tools.description: Extract fields from one document and wait for the result in the same call. Send the file as base64. Accepts PDF, JPG, PNG, TIFF and BMP up to 10 MB; use typless_extract_data_async for larger files. The document type must exist in the customer's Typless account. Typless API: POST /api/v1/extract-data

tools.name: typless_extract_data_async
tools.description: Start an extraction and return an extraction_id at once (HTTP 202). Send the file as base64 (file_base64) or as a public https URL (file_url), not both. file_url files can be up to 35 MiB and must download within 60 seconds. Read the result later with typless_get_extraction. Typless API: POST /api/v

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: typless_extract_data_async · Private data: typless_extract_data, typless_extract_data_async · Public sink: typless_extract_data, typless_extract_data_async.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: typless_extract_data_async · Private data: typless_extract_data, typless_extract_data_async · Public sink: typless_extract_data, typless_extract_data_async

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
